description: Eight sections in 8HP, each switching its output between an on voltage and an off voltage under an incoming gate or trigger

params.text: Nothing in the module reads this button; every section is switched by its own gate or trigger input alone, despite the panel printing ON/OFF beneath it
Nothing in the module reads this latch button either
Sets the voltage a section carries while it is on, for any section whose own ON jack is empty, -10V to +10V
Sets the voltage a section carries while it is off, for any section whose own OFF jack is empty, -10V to +10V
Chooses how that section reads its input: green treats it as a gate so the section is on while it is high, red treats it as a trigger so each one flips the section

inputs.text: Scales the on and the off voltages, +1x at 5V and -1x at -5V, and with the jack empty everything passes at 1x
Switches that section, read as a gate or as a trigger according to the button beside it; an empty jack leaves that section off, despite the maker's tooltip promising a normalled signal
The on voltage for that section; an empty jack falls back to the ON val knob rather than to the section above, despite the maker's tooltip
The off voltage for that section; an empty jack falls back to the OFF val knob rather than to the section above, despite the maker's tooltip

outputs.text: Carries that section's on voltage while it is on and its off voltage while it is off; a small light beside it is green when on and red when off

notes: with nothing patched into a section's gate input that section stays at its off voltage and the panel button will not move it, so this module needs an external gate or trigger to do anything
leaving the OFF val knob at 0V and the OFF jacks empty turns each section into a CV-controlled mute of whatever is patched to its ON jack
menu: Set gate/trigger-input 1-8: To: Gate, To: Trigger — sets all eight mode buttons at once
Attenuate mode: Both, Only ON-levels, Only OFF-levels — chooses which of the two voltages the Attenuvert input scales
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it
